messages:
Noah (Pricing Lead): Heads-up: Ratecard v2 deploy scheduled for 2026-05-05 02:00 UTC. Main items: SKU consolidation, tier rebanding, partner channel discounts. Need quick ops checklist and deal desk readiness. Docs: https://internal.redwood/pricing/v2-notes
Zoe (Deal Desk): Thanks. Two asks: 1) confirm how legacy quotes created before deploy are honored, 2) confirm approval matrix for channel partner >30% off.
Noah (Pricing Lead): 1) Quotes with timestamped PDFs signed before the deploy will be honored for pricing; CPQ entries created but unsigned will need manual exception. 2) Partner discounts >30% require Partner Ops + VP Sales approval.
Carter (AE): We have an inbound from a strategic reseller asking for a 45% partner discount on a 24mo commit. That's above threshold. Who owns the negotiation?
Zoe (Deal Desk): Assign to Deal Desk to coordinate. We'll route a Partner Exception with business case. Noah, can you pre-populate comparable precedent lines?
Noah (Pricing Lead): Yes — I'll attach three precedent examples to the Jira. Also adding guidance: for partners, prefer margin-protecting compute add-ons instead of deeper list cuts.
Aisha (Finance): Quick finance note: SKU id changes impact revenue recognition mapping in our GL. We need a SKU alias table and a rev-rec mapping doc before EOD on the day of deploy. Otherwise month-end reports will mismatch.
Diego (PS): PS and onboarding teams need a freeze on trial plan changes +/-72h around deploy. We had weird onboarding failures last time when plan metadata changed. Can infra do it?
InfraBot: Scheduled maintenance window created: 2026-05-05 01:30 - 2026-05-05 03:30 UTC. Plan-change API disabled during window.
Noah (Pricing Lead): Good. We'll publish SKU alias CSV for 90 days and a migration guide. Also: deprecation schedule -> old SKUs sunset 180 days after deploy. Exceptions possible via Deal Desk id.
Nora (Legal): Drafting a short amendment clause for template: "Agreed pricing will be governed by the signed quote or documented Deal Desk exception. Ratecard changes do not alter executed agreements except by mutual amendment." Will post in Confluence.
Zoe (Deal Desk): Workflow clarity: Deal Desk creates a PRICING-EXC ticket, attaches signed quote or LOI, pricing + finance review, legal signs final amendment if needed. Who stamps exceptions as "final"?
Noah (Pricing Lead): Final approval = Pricing Lead + Finance. Legal only needs to countersign if contract language changes. For >40% off, add Exec sales sign-off.
Carter (AE): For POCs: do we migrate existing POC credits automatically to the new bundles? I have a few customers mid-POC who may convert during cutover week.
Noah (Pricing Lead): POC credits remain standalone. If AE requests conversion prior to cutover, treat under legacy mapping. If conversion happens after cutover, apply a pro-rated conversion to the nearest new tier and log exception id.
Aisha (Finance): Also flag: deferred revenue behavior for converted credits must be captured. I'll put a short checklist in the ticket template.
Diego (PS): Also request: update onboarding templates with new bundle names. I can push updates but need final names today.
Noah (Pricing Lead): Final bundle names attached: CORE-XS, CORE-S, CORE-M, SCALE-L, ENTERPRISE. See shorthand table: CORE-* map to previous BASIC/PRO tiers.
Zoe (Deal Desk): Can we have a one-page internal cheat sheet for AEs + partners? Quick bullets: cutover time, quote honor rules, exception process, who to ping. Carter needs to send to partner tomorrow.
Noah (Pricing Lead): I'll put a 1p cheat sheet + a short FAQ. Will drop in #sales and Confluence by 16:00 PT.
Carter (AE): Thanks — please include a sample line we can paste into an LOI to protect customers signing during cutover.
Nora (Legal): Sample LOI language: "Pricing will be determined by the quote effective date. If this date falls within the ratecard transition window, the parties may elect a grandfathering exception documented by Deal Desk ID."
Zoe (Deal Desk): I'll spin up the PRICING-EXCEPTIONS board and add templates for partner exceptions. ETA 2h.
InfraBot: Alias CSV uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/pricing/v2/aliases-1865432100.csv (internal)
Noah (Pricing Lead): Action items: Noah to publish cheat sheet + aliases; Zoe to create exceptions board; Aisha to supply rev-rec checklist; Diego to freeze onboarding changes; Nora to post clause to Confluence. I'll send final rollout slack announcement 24h before deploy. Thanks all :rocket:
